title: Finite-strain J2 periodic cell with a true spherical void
purpose: Freeze one reproducible software-regression contract for the public finite-strain J2 affine-periodic lifecycle without presenting a coarse mesh as an RVE reference solution.
physics: Three-dimensional finite-strain logarithmic J2 plasticity in a unit periodic cube containing a geometric spherical void under isochoric macroscopic tension.

execution.command: AGENTFEM_REQUIRE_RVE_GOLDEN=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_periodic_void_fixture.py && agentfem mpi-run -n 2 -- python tests/parallel_periodic_void_j2_driver.py
execution.evidence: The serial test and two-rank driver use the public model.step provider, exact source-node periodic equations, provider-owned quadrature state, physical-weighted statistics, complete-cell homogenization, Hill--Mandel work evidence and the ordinary SimulationResult lifecycle. Linux CI runs the two-rank cross-platform invariant mode; the declared Darwin/arm64 reference stack additionally runs the fixed-stack Golden mode.

observables: Full row-major homogenized first-Piola stress normalized by the complete periodic-cell reference volume.
Physical-weighted mean, 95th percentile and 99th percentile of accepted integration-point PEEQ.
Meshed solid reference fraction, complete-cell normalization and portable mesh identity.
Periodic pairing/equation mismatch, positive deformation Jacobian, Hill--Mandel residual and SENER component closure as invariant gates.
Maximum PEEQ is retained as a localization diagnostic and is not a Golden acceptance quantity.
acceptance: The fixed-stack numerical quantities satisfy their versioned Golden tolerances only after the portable mesh identity matches; reference-stack required mode fails rather than skips when the declared stack or Gmsh is unavailable.
The accepted load factors are exactly 0, 0.5 and 1, and the public result contains provider-owned F/P/S/MISES/SENER/ELENER/HARDENER/FP/PEEQ fields.
Periodic pairing remains below 1e-12 L, solved equation mismatch below 1e-10 L, minimum quadrature J above 0.99, and maximum Hill--Mandel relative residual below 1e-8.
SENER equals ELENER plus HARDENER at accepted integration points to an absolute tolerance of 1e-12.
The two-rank driver reproduces the same Golden quantities and mesh identity.

quantities.name: homogenized_first_piola_stress
quantities.description: Row-major complete-cell-volume average of the accepted first-Piola field.

quantities.name: peeq_mean
quantities.description: Physical-weighted mean accepted integration-point equivalent plastic strain.

quantities.name: peeq_p95
quantities.description: Left-continuous physical-weighted empirical 95th percentile of accepted PEEQ.

quantities.name: peeq_p99
quantities.description: Left-continuous physical-weighted empirical 99th percentile of accepted PEEQ.

quantities.name: solid_reference_fraction
quantities.description: Meshed solid reference volume divided by the complete unit-cell reference volume.

refinement_certificate.wording: Successive-refinement stability, not formal asymptotic convergence or a GCI claim.

scope: Public serial exact-affine and distributed dolfinx_mpc finite-strain J2 periodic-cell routes.
Geometric spherical cavity with matching periodic first-order tetrahedral boundary meshes.
Fixed two-increment isochoric macroscopic deformation and physical-weighted quadrature statistics.
limitations: AgentFEM 0.2.5 identifies the clean source used to create the reference; the candidate AgentFEM version is intentionally not an applicability gate, so future releases are compared against this Golden rather than skipped.

The recorded Darwin kernel release is provenance, not an applicability gate; system family, architecture, numerical dependencies, scalar/MPI contract, explicit Gmsh generation policy and portable mesh identity determine applicability.

Linux CI requires the two-rank invariant mode but does not claim that a Linux result is the Darwin/arm64 fixed-stack Golden; the strict numerical Golden remains a declared-reference-stack maintainer check.
The h/L=0.25 Golden is a fixed-stack software regression, not a mesh-converged RVE reference solution; its meshed solid-volume error is about 1.074 percent.
Maximum PEEQ is localization-sensitive and remains diagnostic rather than an acceptance quantity.
Hill--Mandel work consistency is not a complete energy balance; plastic dissipation and an independent generalized macro reaction remain open.
The Zhang--Feng--Khandelwal external gate remains failed, so this card does not promote finite-strain J2 to externally verified maturity.
